method_note: Counted oral technical sessions in the official 2026 ASC program (Whistler, 26-30 Jul 2026) 'Daily Session Decision Grids': 55 sessions (52 regular + 3 special sessions/panels); the poster session was excluded. The program lists 363 unique paper numbers (incl. posters). Numbered session series were grouped into their official topic tracks; each session split across at most 2 taxonomy keywords (0.5/0.5). Keywords below 0.02 omitted (space-robotics 0.009, space-science 0.009), so weights sum slightly below 1.
